name: Hotel Barriere Le Majestic Cannes
positioning: Le Majestic, a Barriere hotel almost one hundred years old, facing the sea on the Croisette in Cannes with a private beach and a heated outdoor pool
best_for: Travelers who want a seafront base on the Croisette near the Palais des Festivals
Families with children aged 4 to 12, with an included Kid's Club

facts.text: The hotel is at 10 Boulevard de La Croisette in Cannes.
The hotel is a 5-minute walk from Cannes train station.
The hotel is a few steps from the Palais des Festivals and 25 minutes from Nice airport.
The hotel is almost one hundred years old.
Beefbar Cannes serves exceptional meats and fine seafood.
La Terrasse Piscine, beside the outdoor pool, serves a sunny summer menu.
The Majestic Bar is a cocktail bar with large armchairs and beams adorned with gold leaf.
The spa uses products from Biologique Recherche.
The hotel has its own sauna, hammam and gym.
Access to the Kid's Club for children aged 4 to 12 is included in the stay.
The hotel offers water sports activities alongside its private beach and heated outdoor pool.
The Riviera Suite has a nautical-inspired theme and two bedrooms, each with a balcony and private marble bathroom.

highlights.text: The Christian Dior Suite is a Haussmann-style apartment with a terrace overlooking the sea and the red carpet.
The Majestic Suite has a heated infinity pool on its terrace, with sea views.
The hotel faces the sea on the Croisette in Cannes, with views of the Palais des Festivals steps.
Ciro's Cannes, on the hotel's private beach, serves reinvented seafood cuisine with panoramic sea views.
The outdoor pool is heated to 27 degrees Celsius all year round.

considerations.text: The private beach is open year-round except during congresses, special events and the hotel's annual closure.
Valet parking costs extra and is priced higher from May to September.
WhataHotel notes the area is busy with visitors during festival season and peak summer months.
